SetGoals.setPersonalizedDescription:
Select from a wide range of options for your monthly ibadat goals and watch your progress illuminate, transforming from new moon to a glowing moon.

Our goal setting feature helps you become your best self as a Muslim-thoughtfully designed to keep your connection with Allah (SWT) strong amid life's demands and wordly pursuits.

introScreen.introText: Embark on your journey to become a better Muslim with Badar
introScreen.subtitleText: Set ibadat goal, track progress in real-time, and elevate your journey as a devoted Muslim with a reflective journal and enriching experiences islamic content

freeTrialScreen.title: GET YOUR 2-MONTH FREE TRIAL
freeTrialScreen.subtitle: With your Badr membership, you unlock features designed to support your journey towards becoming a better Muslim.
freeTrialScreen.feature1: Monthly goal setting and tracking to enrich your journey with personalized insights.
freeTrialScreen.feature2: A journal feature focused on character development, helping you be mindful of your behaviors aligned with Islamic values.
freeTrialScreen.feature3: Customized notifications to help you stay on track by setting reminders and schedules.
freeTrialScreen.feature4: A private community to connect with friends and family, share progress, and provide mutual support.
freeTrialScreen.feature5: Rich Islamic content to support your spiritual journey, including articles, podcasts, and videos.
freeTrialScreen.feature6: Monthly achievement reports, illuminating your progress and fostering continuous growth.

paymentMethodScreen.subtitle: A valid payment method is required to start your free trial. You can change plans or cancel anytime.
paymentMethodScreen.trialPricingNote: First 2 months free, then just $10.99/month. Cancel anytime.
paymentMethodScreen.desc3Month: $0 for 2 months, then $29.99 every 3 months after. If you've already used your free trial before, billing begins immediately.
paymentMethodScreen.desc6Month: $0 for 2 months, then $54.99 every 3 months after. If you've already used your free trial before, billing begins immediately.
paymentMethodScreen.descAnnual: $0 for 2 months, then $99.99 every 3 months after. If you've already used your free trial before, billing begins immediately.
